main.content:
==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɡɛtə/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈɡɛtə(ɹ)/|/-ɾə(ɹ)/|a=GA}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛtə|ɛtə(ɹ)|s2=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|get|ter}}

===Etymology 1===
{{ety|en|:af|get<id:obtain>|-er<id:agent noun>|text=+|tree=1}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# One who, or that which, [[get]]s.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1838|author=William Evans; Thomas Evans|title=The Friends' Library
|passage=Many times things would open in him to admiration, showing to rich men and the eager '''getters''' of this world, the danger they were in of hurting themselves, by hindering their growth in the truth.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2009|author=Jodi Newbern|title=Regifting Revival!: A Guide to Reusing Gifts Graciously|page=15
|passage=In any case, now we have defined the identities and established the unique characteristics of all types of gift givers and gift '''getters'''.}}
# {{lb|en|object-oriented programming}} A [[function]] used to [[retrieve]] the value of some [[property]] of an [[object]], contrasted with the [[setter]].
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=2002
|author=James Steven Perry
|title=Java Management Extensions
|chapter=2
|isbn=0596002459
|page=47
|passage=A proper '''getter''' must return the type of its attribute.}}
# {{lb|en|sciences}} A material which is included in a [[vacuum]] system or device for [[removing]] [[gas]] by [[sorption]].
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=1979
|author=G. L. Weissler; Robert Warner Carlson
|title=Vacuum Physics and Technology
|chapter=5
|isbn=0124759149
|pages=194–195
|passage=Titanium has become the preferred '''getter''' for general vacuum-pumping applications because of its relatively high vapor pressure characteristic and its broad spectrum chemical reactivity.}}
# {{lb|en|mining|historical}} A [[miner]] who [[dig|dug]] [[coal]], contrasted with the {{m|en|putter}}, who took it to the surface.

=====Synonyms=====
* {{sense|computing}} [[accessor]]

=====Derived terms=====
{{col|en|attention getter|gettering|getter-up|go-getter|placegetter|timbergetter|vote-getter|grocery getter}}

=====See also=====
* [[setter]]

===Etymology 2===
From the noun

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|sciences|transitive}} To [[remove]] [[gas]] by [[sorption]], using a getter.
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=2003
|author=John F. O'Hanlon
|title=A Users Guide to Vacuum Technology
|chapter=14
|isbn=0471270520
|page=247
|passage=Many reactive metals rapidly pump large quantities of active gases because they '''getter''' (react with) the gases.}}

=====Synonyms=====
* [[get]]
